history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young woman with long, dark brown hair braided into two pigtails, adorned with delicate white and pink flowers and green leaves, stands in a vibrant garden. She wears a flowing, light green off-the-shoulder dress with ruffled details and a sparkling diamond necklace. Her head is tilted back slightly, and she has a joyful, serene expression with her eyes closed and a gentle smile. Her skin is fair and glowing, with a hint of blush on her cheeks. The background is a lush garden filled with a variety of colorful flowers in shades of pink, purple, and white, with green foliage and trees visible. The lighting is soft and natural, suggesting a sunny day, creating a dreamy and ethereal atmosphere. The overall mood is romantic, peaceful, and whimsical. The image has a painterly, fantasy art style with a soft focus effect.
